title: Full Body Strength Training Workout Routine
transcript: hey everyone this is a 40 minute workout i did last week while i was on vacation so first i'm super setting lat pull downs with the single leg deadlifts and i am doing three rounds total 12 reps on the first one and 12 reps on each leg for the second exercise next up is the chest press and i am super setting this with the hip thrusts in the next clip and i am doing three rounds and 12 reps of each exercise once again i rested for about one to two minutes between each round next i am doing the lateral raises for three sets of 15 reps and i'm doing this as a standalone exercise so i am not super setting this with anything else lastly i'm doing the plank shoulder taps for three sets of 20 reps to finish up
summary:
1. Superset of lat pull downs and single leg deadlifts: 3 rounds, 12 reps for each exercise, rest for 1-2 minutes between each round.
2. Superset of chest press and hip thrusts: 3 rounds, 12 reps for each exercise, rest for 1-2 minutes between each round.
3. Lateral raises: 3 sets, 15 reps, standalone exercise.
4. Plank shoulder taps: 3 sets, 20 reps to finish the workout routine.
